review.placements: Release is mem/free; process handle rights are process/attach/rights; offset loads are instruction metadata; neutral allocation and injection API sets are capabilities.
review.scope: Moved rules retain file types, architecture, size bounds, match conditions and suppressors; VirtualFree inherits its original explicit source scope.
review.intent_correction: OpenProcess leaves creation selectors and the neutral API profile leaves evasion selectors. Those parent selectors must require their advertised creation or evasion claims.
review.evidence_correction: The e_lfanew label was unsupported by an offset-load pattern. The metadata matcher now excludes SIB ModRM encodings that did not encode the asserted displacement.
review.criticality_correction: Complete allocation and remote-thread API evidence is notable, rather than a family or fileless component.
review.locale_correction: Explicit Turbopack runtime evidence disqualifies the standalone locale-resource premise, including decoded fragments smaller than the parent bundle.
